mapper.select: SELECT distinct SEC_ACCT_ID id, SEC_ACCT_NAME name from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID secId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR secAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ t.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId,/**证券账户**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE settdateDate,/**交割日期**/ stl.SETTLE_DATE fundSettleDate,/**资金交收日**/ t.INV_AIM invAim,/**会计分类**/ t.CHL_ID chlId,/**通道代码**/ t.SHARE_AMT dealNum,/**成交数量**/ t.CPRICE_AMT tradeAmt,/**本币交易金额**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息总额**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE cprice,/**净价**/ ttfd.FEE_AMT brokerage,/**经手费**/ ttfd1.FEE_AMT stlAmt,/**结算费**/ NVL(ttfd2.FEE_AMT,0) commissionPay,/**应付佣金**/ NVL(ttfd5.FEE_AMT,0) commission,/**净佣金**/ ttfd3.FEE_AMT dealFeeAmt,/**交易手续费**/ ttfd4.FEE_AMT stlFeeAmt,/**结算手续费**/ t.TRADE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ t.MY_ACCT_NO myAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE =#{BUSI_TYPE_02} AND STL.ORDER_TYPE NOT LIKE 'N%' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B01} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd1 ON ttfd1.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd1.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B07} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd2 ON ttfd2.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd2.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B05} and ttfd2.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE=#{YES_NO_N} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd3 ON ttfd3.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd3.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B06} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd4 ON ttfd4.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd4.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B08} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd5 ON ttfd5.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd5.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B05} and ttfd2.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE=#{YES_NO_Y} where t.BUSI_TYPE =#{BUSI_TYPE_02} and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
